guide.description: Canonical conformance test guide. Three rules: rule-high (keywords: critical, sensitive → outcome HIGH), rule-low (keywords: public, open → outcome LOW), rule-ctrl-a (keywords: controlled, restricted → outcome HIGH/CTRL-A). Tests: scan finds keyword hits, evaluate aggregates outcomes, evaluateMany delegates to first guide.
guide.name: Reference Guide 1

inline.description: Applies when document contains sensitive or critical content. Contributes HIGH level marking.
inline.name: High Sensitivity

inline.description: Applies when document is public or open. Contributes LOW level marking.
inline.name: Low Sensitivity

inline.description: Applies when document contains controlled or restricted data. Contributes HIGH/CTRL-A marking.
inline.name: Control A
